name: Ghoul Fang
summary: In Duskwood, travelers face the forest’s encroaching darkness, and Ghoul Fang is gathered for Madame Eva’s protective talismans. The fangs are essential to her work in Darkshire.

sections.title: Trophies of the Restless Dead
sections.body: Ravenous undead haunt Duskwood’s woods and graves. Flesh Eaters lurk near the burial grounds, while Rotted Ones roam among the trees. Taking a fang from these creatures is grim work. It proves survival against the dead threatening Darkshire’s borders.

sections.title: Occult Reagents
sections.body: Madame Eva is Darkshire’s fortune teller and mystic. She sees terrible omens around travelers crossing Duskwood, so she enchants the Totem of Infliction with ghoul fangs, skeletal fingers, and arachnid venom. The charm turns the forest’s dark forces against violent assault and protects its bearer.

faq.q: Where can Ghoul Fangs be found?
faq.answer: Various ghouls haunt Duskwood’s graveyards and lonely pathways. They include Plague Spreaders, Brain Eaters, Bone Chewers, Fetid Corpses, Rotted Ones, and Flesh Eaters.
Madame Eva, the mystic in Darkshire, needs Ghoul Fangs to craft the defensive Totem of Infliction.

faq.q: Why does Madame Eva need them?
aliases: what does madame eva do with fangs
faq.answer: Madame Eva senses danger gathering around travelers. She combines the fangs with skeleton fingers and spider venom to enchant a protective totem that punishes anyone who strikes its bearer.

angles.text: As an Alliance adventurer helping embattled Darkshire, you can turn Duskwood’s horrors into tools for survival against the encroaching Scourge-like taint.
